name: zm-compute
description: Mezze: throwaway VMs for your agent: zm's sandbox tools (sandbox_create, _exec, _list, _renew, _stop) over MCP. If zm is missing and you allow it, installs a pinned, checksum-verified zm release on first use.

install_zm.title: Install zm if it is missing
install_zm.description: If zm is not on this machine, download the zm release this plugin pins from the project's GitHub releases (SHA-256 checked against its SHA256SUMS) into ~/.local/lib/zm and link ~/.local/bin/zm. No sudo. A zm you already have is never replaced.
